# Amazon Bedrock API Reference — captured 2026-07-04

## Service Endpoints / API operation groups (from Welcome page)

1. **Amazon Bedrock** (control plane) — create/manage/fine-tune/evaluate models
2. **Agents for Amazon Bedrock** — create/manage agents [now "Agents Classic"; maintenance-mode note]
3. **Agents for Amazon Bedrock Runtime** — model invocation, knowledge-base querying [Agents Classic note]
4. **Data Automation for Amazon Bedrock** — create/manage Data Automation resources, generate insights
5. **Runtime for Amazon Bedrock Data Automation** — process data with a data automation project
6. **Amazon Bedrock Runtime** — run inference using Bedrock models

## Notes
- Welcome page lists operation GROUPS, not the full per-operation list.
- vs prior cache (2026-05-18): prior cache listed bedrock / bedrock-runtime / bedrock-agent / bedrock-agent-runtime. Page now also surfaces Data Automation (control) + Data Automation Runtime as distinct groups. Data Automation is an existing Bedrock capability; group listing on Welcome is a doc-surfacing change, not a new service. No new agent/governance API surface.

Updated: 2026-07-04 — Operation-group listing refreshed (Data Automation groups now surfaced; Agents relabeled Classic). No full per-operation diff available from this page. No reportable addition.
